name: sdd-pipeline
description: Spec-Driven Development pipeline: a full delivery team as gated, traceable skills — discovery→PRD→diagrams→FSD→architecture→security→backlog→test-plan→implement→infra→verify→ship. Autopilot & copilot modes; SSOT/DRY/YAGNI code bar. Multi-agent, stack-neutral, dev + non-dev friendly.
